note: Parity cases for the deadline due-date phrasing, shared by two suites. tests/unit/chronos-dates.test.ts checks the migrated SvelteKit surface against them; tests/unit/gui/test_chronos_parity.py checks the legacy NiceGUI service that the surface replaces. Both have to agree, which is what makes this a parity fixture rather than two independent expectations. Offsets are plain seconds, so every case is timezone- and DST-independent by construction; the last two exist to pin that down rather than to leave it implied.
